# Rescue plan: Nuwakot district (medium-06)

**Total cost: 282** (212 minutes of driving + 70 in deferral penalties). Everyone who can be reached safely is rescued, while two people must wait for a later wave.

## Constraints
- **Evacuation point:** Jwalamukhi shelter is the only valid drop-off. Gajuri school is not designated, so the car can pass through it but cannot leave anyone there.
- **Closed roads:** The Jwalamukhi–Syaphru road has collapsed, and the Belkot–Kalika road is buried by a landslide.
- **Flooded road:** I treated Kalika–Nilkantha as unusable because of the fast floodwater and a truck being swept off it this morning.
- **Cut-off locations:** Without that road, Nilkantha temple and Suryagadhi market can't be reached, so the widow and the bus driver must be deferred.
- **Quickest usable route:** Jwalamukhi to Kalika via Gajuri takes 38 minutes, while Syaphru is a further 30 minutes beyond Kalika.

## Plan
The injured farmer is collected on the first trip, which adds no cost.

<plan>
defer nilkantha-temple elderly 1
defer suryagadhi-market adult 1
drive car1 jwalamukhi-shelter gajuri-school
drive car1 gajuri-school kalika-temple
drive car1 kalika-temple syaphru-care-home
load car1 injured 1
drive car1 syaphru-care-home kalika-temple
load car1 elderly 3
drive car1 kalika-temple gajuri-school
drive car1 gajuri-school jwalamukhi-shelter
unload car1 injured 1
unload car1 elderly 3
drive car1 jwalamukhi-shelter gajuri-school
drive car1 gajuri-school kalika-temple
load car1 elderly 3
drive car1 kalika-temple gajuri-school
drive car1 gajuri-school jwalamukhi-shelter
unload car1 elderly 3
</plan>

## Cost breakdown

| Item | Details | Cost |
|---|---|---|
| Trip 1 | Jwalamukhi → Gajuri → Kalika → Syaphru → Kalika → Gajuri → Jwalamukhi (19 + 19 + 30 + 30 + 19 + 19) | 136 |
| Trip 2 | Jwalamukhi → Gajuri → Kalika → Gajuri → Jwalamukhi (19 + 19 + 19 + 19) | 76 |
| Deferred | Elderly widow at Nilkantha temple | 50 |
| Deferred | Bus driver at Suryagadhi market | 20 |
| **Total** | | **282** |

## Why this is the cheapest option
With seven reachable people and four seats, rescuing everyone reachable takes two trips. Deferring more people would cost more:

| Option | Driving | Added penalties | Cost before the 70 for unreachable people |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Rescue all seven (this plan)** | 212 | 0 | **212** |
| Defer the farmer, make two trips for all six seniors | 152 | 80 | 232 |
| Defer the farmer and two seniors, make one trip | 76 | 180 | 256 |
| Make one trip with the farmer and three seniors, defer three seniors | 136 | 150 | 286 |
| Defer all seven | 0 | 380 | 380 |

COST: 282
